## Procedure and coverage

After an official update from 1.0 to 1.1 through OI.Share and a baseline check, the 12,582,912-byte r01 file was copied as DCOLYMP/E1489999.BIN, its hash checked on the card after reconnecting, and installed once with OK held at power-on; OK stayed held through the lamp's steady and blinking phases. The camera was then started normally without the card.

- Normal boot and English menus after the update card was removed.
- A partial functional check found no issue; the owner later said the camera works overall.

## Limits and assumptions

- The checked subset is not recorded; the requested checklist (capture, video, playback, AF/IBIS, EVF, every menu and help, sleep and power cycles) was not completed.
- No screen recording, flash readback or factory-data comparison; the bytes OI.Share installed were not hashed.
- OK was held longer than needed while waiting for guidance; no minimum hold time is established.
- One body; not reproduced by the Atlas.
- The stock input matches the Atlas's 1.1 container digest, as the project's profile states.
